name: tpc-h-analytics
description: The semantic layer of an enterprise data agent over the TPC-H retail model: tables, columns, metrics, dimensions, domains and queries, with lineage and attribution relations.

vertexSchemas.name: Node
vertexSchemas.description: A semantic-layer node: Table / Column / Metric / Dimension / Domain / Query

properties.name: name
properties.description: Node name (table / column / metric / dimension / domain / query id)

properties.name: entityType
properties.description: Table / Column / Metric / Dimension / Domain / Query

properties.name: dataType
properties.description: Column SQL type (DECIMAL(15,2), INTEGER, CHAR(1), DATE, ...)

properties.name: tableName
properties.description: The table a column belongs to

properties.name: expression
properties.description: The SQL aggregation expression (the metric definition)

properties.name: sqlText
properties.description: The SQL of a standard query (TPC-H)

properties.name: graphProperty
properties.description: The fact-graph property this node binds to (dimension/metric), or grain=property

edgeSchemas.name: Relation
edgeSchemas.description: A semantic-layer relation: hasColumn / references / computedFrom / usesColumn / groupedBy / definedBy / contributesTo / belongsTo / readsTable / dimensionColumn

properties.name: xrelation
properties.description: Reverse relation name; equals relation when it has no inverse

properties.name: relationLabel
properties.description: 中文关系名 (包含字段 / 外键引用 / 取自表 / ...)

properties.name: relationFamily
properties.description: 关系家族 (结构 / 血缘 / 指标 / 归因 / 维度)
